episodes.title: Warm-up
episodes.question: What changes between prefill, decode and cache reuse under recorded load?
episodes.summary: Follow a request through prefill, decode and the KV cache using the published exploratory study.
episodes.evidence: Exploratory recorded study; the offline self-test is synthetic only.

episodes.title: Measure what matters
episodes.question: When load rises, which latency and throughput signals explain the user-visible change?
episodes.summary: Inspect matched recorded load levels through latency, throughput and telemetry.
episodes.evidence: Recorded exploratory comparison; capacity was not established.

episodes.title: Equal-work runtime baseline
episodes.question: What do matched inference engines deliver under the same declared default-configuration protocol?
episodes.summary: Compare inference engines under the same model, corpus, template and delivered-output contract.

episodes.title: Prefix reuse
episodes.question: How much does controlled prefix reuse change latency and goodput?
episodes.summary: Control shared-prefix ratios and compare cold and warm cache behavior.

episodes.title: Batching, scheduling and mixed traffic
episodes.question: Where do scheduling policies help or hurt a controlled mix of short and long requests?
episodes.summary: Study scheduler behavior under controlled long and short traffic mixes.

episodes.title: Attention kernels and precision
episodes.question: Which verified kernel and precision choices improve performance without changing the contract?
episodes.summary: Compare attention backends, then weight and KV precision separately.

episodes.title: Speculative decoding and structured outputs
episodes.question: When does a compatible proposal path help once structured-output correctness is held fixed?
episodes.summary: Evaluate proposal paths and constrained generation without assuming a speedup.

episodes.title: Parallelism within one node
episodes.question: How should one fixed GPU budget be divided inside a node?
episodes.summary: Compare supported data, tensor and justified pipeline or expert parallel layouts.

episodes.title: Parallelism across nodes
episodes.question: When do cross-node communication costs erase the benefit of added accelerators?
episodes.summary: Test placement and communication costs on a documented multi-node topology.

episodes.title: Prefill/decode disaggregation and cache-aware routing
episodes.question: Can separated serving pools and cache-aware routing beat a matched colocated baseline?
episodes.summary: Compare colocated and supported disaggregated serving with queue- and cache-aware routing.

episodes.title: Slurm and Kubernetes orchestration
episodes.question: How do representative scheduled jobs and long-running services differ operationally?
episodes.summary: Compare platform choices separately from inference engines.

episodes.title: Model internals: weights to optimization
episodes.question: How do weights, attention, gradients and optimizer state connect in an inspectable model?
episodes.summary: Trace model internals with a small inspectable system.

episodes.title: LoRA and QLoRA with held-out evaluation
episodes.question: What do adapter methods change under fixed data, budgets and held-out evaluation?
episodes.summary: Compare adapter training with fixed controls and independent evaluation.

episodes.title: SYSTEM 1 and LLMs on labeled decision tasks
episodes.question: When does a typed decision system outperform or complement an LLM on a labeled contract?
episodes.summary: Compare typed and LLM decision approaches on one versioned task contract.

episodes.title: Packaging, accelerator preflight and memory containment
episodes.question: Can a release prove accelerator visibility, model loading and bounded memory before traffic?
episodes.summary: Verify reproducible packaging, accelerator preflight and memory containment.

episodes.title: Saturation, SLO and cost
episodes.question: Where does offered load stop producing SLO-qualified goodput?
episodes.summary: Sweep concurrency and offered rate to find qualified goodput and attributable cost.

episodes.title: Release gates, recovery and capstone synthesis
episodes.question: Do promising settings still win when regression, rollback and recovery gates are applied?
episodes.summary: Combine promising settings and exercise release and recovery gates.
